|lore=Human-replica droid. Programmed to function as Xizor’s personal bodyguard and assassin. Black Sun agent. Cost 9 million credits. Worth every decicred.

|strategy=A human replica droid, [[Guri]] was the personal bodyguard for [[Prince Xizor]]. She's the only human replica droid known to be programmed as an assassin. [[Prince Xizor]] paid nine million credits to obtain her. She fought [[Luke Skywalker]] in hand to hand combat - and lost.

Reference images came from Toppps trading cards and Dark Horse Comics for &quot;Shadows of the Empire.&quot;<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/reflections2/dark/small/guri.html</ref>
